title: Hearty Hangover Jamaican Cheese Casserole
description: A flexitarian-friendly Jamaican dish featuring garlic sauce and wood-fired bake, perfect for hangover cure, with a cultured and cheese-pull twist.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat and saute the scotch bonnet peppers and garlic until softened.
Add the flour to the saucepan and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the coconut milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shredded cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the wood-fired baked beans, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the cheese sauce and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in the preheated wood-fired oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown and set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
